title: Medical debt becomes a visible CFPB complaint category
source_unit: published CFPB complaint record represented in a 2025 product/sub-product aggregate snapshot

denominator.unit: all published complaint records represented in the snapshot

medical_debt_records.unit: published complaint records; Debt collection -> Medical debt

debt_collection_records.unit: published complaint records; Debt collection parent product

observations.method: Read the nested Debt collection -> Medical debt bucket and divide by the snapshot total and Debt collection parent bucket; no record-level deduplication or outcome inference.
observations.uncertainty: The aggregate is a published administrative record, not a probability sample. Product/subproduct selection, complaint propensity, screening, publication rules, and API aggregation shape the count.
observations.subgroup: 2025 published CFPB complaint records represented in the aggregate snapshot.
observations.counterinterpretation: A low or high visible count may reflect route access, coding, publication, product use, or reporting behavior rather than the underlying prevalence or severity of medical debt.

related_sources.claim: The method note defines the nested product/subproduct extraction and visibility boundary.
The machine output preserves counts, shares, input hash, and limits.
The official API snapshot contains the parent and nested subproduct buckets.

boundary: This is complaint-system visibility, not medical-debt prevalence, harm incidence, a rate among debtors, verified remedy, money recovered, care restoration, trust, switching, or exit. No CFPB record is joined to a MEPS person or household.
